messages:
maya: Following up on the postmortemwe need owners + concrete short timelines for the GPU headroom + autoscale remediation items. Can folks call dibs?

eli: I can take scheduler tuning end-to-end (binpack + preemption decay). Plan: propose conservative config by Mon, run 24h A/B canary Wed.

priya: I'll own headroom sims and cost modelling. Proposal: baseline replay + +15% and +30% legs; capture p50/p95/p99/p999 and GPU-hours. ETA 72h for first results.

maya: perfect. any blockers for test cluster?

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-2030-01: Scheduler draft (owner=eli) due=2026-04-06.

devfin: procurement note: temporary burst credits ok for up to 96h; formal reserved increases >12% need finance signoff. Priya, if cost > $10k for projection, we need a quick exec OK.

priya: noted. I'll keep the projection under that cap if possible and call out exact $$ in tracker.

tony: I'll validate canary rollback and emergency drain. Suggest a dry-run 24h before canary. ops-bot, schedule dry-run?

ops-bot: [auto] Created task INC-2030-02: Emergency-drain dry-run. Assigned to tony. Due=2026-04-07.

eli: scheduler snippet (preview):
```
preemption: true
binpackScoreWeight: 1.15
maxPreemptionsPerCycle: 2
schedulerBurstMs: 25
```

maya: ownership recap: eli=scheduler tuning + canary, priya=headroom sims + cost, tony=drain + rollback validation, maya=tracker + PD alerts. Deadlines: eli Mon draft, priya 72h results, tony dry-run 24h pre-canary.

priya: requesting staging cluster now (matching GPU families & drivers). Will post kubeconfig in tracker when ready.

ops-bot: [auto] Scheduled recurring HEADROOM-REVIEW weekly for 6 weeks. Next run=2026-04-10.

maya: acceptance criteria: either (A) two sims show tail stable with <=6% cost delta, or (B) scheduler canary reduces p999 >=12% without cost >7%. If met, promote and open procurement.

eli: will add fail-fast automation: abort canary + auto-rollback if p999 >10% or tail-util >80% for 30m.

devfin: finance ok to fund the initial sims. Priya, tag me in tracker when you upload cost numbers.

tony: will run drain dry-run and post steps/logs to tracker. Assigning oncall to monitor during canary.

maya: great. reconvene Fri 10:00 if we have results; otherwise async updates in the tracker.
